wayland.title: A heads-up about Wayland
wayland.body: You're on Wayland, which has no standard way for an app to capture a global keyboard shortcut. Escriba's shortcut may not respond, and that isn't something you can grant permission for.
wayland.alternative: Everything else works. You can start dictation from the tray icon with Free dictation, and correct written text from Settings without using the microphone at all.

models.title: Transkripsiyon Modelleri
models.description: Bir transkripsiyon modeli seçin veya ek modeller indirin. Farklı modeller değişen doğruluk ve hız seviyeleri sunar.

rescan.tooltip: Escriba dışında modeller klasörüne veya Hugging Face önbelleğine eklenen modelleri yeniden tara

transcribe_with_post_process.description: İsteğe bağlı: Transkripsiyonunuza her zaman AI son işleme uygulayan özel bir kısayol tuşu.

transcribe_translate.name: Transcribe and Translate
transcribe_translate.description: Converts your speech into text and translates it to your chosen language.

voice_edit.description: Copies the selected text, listens to your instruction, and replaces the selection with the result.

read_selection.name: Read selection aloud
read_selection.description: Select text in any app and Escriba reads it aloud. Press again to stop.

language.title: Dil
language.description: Konuşma tanıma dilini seçin. 'Otomatik' seçeneği dili kendisi belirler, ancak belirli bir dil seçmek o dildeki doğruluğu artırabilir.

pushToTalk.label: Bas Konuş
pushToTalk.description: Kaydetmek için basılı tutun, durdurmak için bırakın

hero.headline: Speak normally. The text shows up wherever you are.
hero.description: Trigger the shortcut from any text field, talk like you talk, and keep working. No switching windows.

general.contextSubtitle: Tune how Escriba listens, transcribes and pastes your text.

appearance.title: Appearance (Pedro Sánchez's idea)
appearance.themeDescription: Day, night, or let Escriba follow your system mode.
appearance.textSizeDescription: Scales the whole interface. For tired eyes or comfortable reading.
appearance.calmModeDescription: Turns the whole app down: no motion, more air, larger text and flat surfaces. Applies while you dictate too.
appearance.highContrastDescription: Stronger ink and sharper borders, without blurred glass.
appearance.colorblindDescription: Success and recording states switch to a safe cyan/violet pair instead of green and red.
appearance.alwaysFocusDescription: Keeps the focus ring visible with the mouse too, not only when navigating by keyboard.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Lets Escriba type the dictated text into other apps.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Lets Escriba hear your voice to transcribe it.

screen.title: Screen & audio recording
screen.description: Lets Sessions capture system audio (the screen itself is not recorded).

reviewBeforePaste.label: Review before pasting
reviewBeforePaste.description: The dictation shows on screen before it is typed: paste it, discard it, or dictate a correction with your shortcut. For delicate emails and formal documents.

dictatedEmojis.label: Dictated emojis
dictatedEmojis.description: Say "emoji" plus its Spanish name and the symbol appears: "emoji cara feliz" becomes 🙂. Names come from Unicode CLDR plus natural aliases.

spokenNumerals.label: Spoken numbers as digits
spokenNumerals.description: Long number phrases become digits: "tres millones y medio" turns into 3.500.000. Only unambiguous sequences convert; "uno de los problemas" stays untouched.

numeralsSpreadsheet.label: Aggressive numbers in spreadsheets
numeralsSpreadsheet.description: With Excel, Numbers or LibreOffice Calc in front, even single numbers become digits: say "cinco" and 5 is typed. Google Sheets in a browser can't be detected.

audioFeedback.label: Sesli Geri Bildirim
audioFeedback.description: Kayıt başladığında ve bittiğinde ses çalar

outputDevice.title: Çıkış Cihazı
outputDevice.description: Geri bildirim sesleri için ses çıkış cihazını seçin

volume.title: Ses Seviyesi
volume.description: Sesli geri bildirimlerin ses seviyesini ayarlayın

pauseMedia.label: Pause media while dictating
pauseMedia.description: Pause Music/Spotify while you dictate and resume when you finish. Only what was playing gets paused.

noiseSuppression.label: Background noise suppression
noiseSuppression.description: Clean up mic noise (fan, keyboard, traffic) before transcribing. Runs locally.

experimentalToggle.label: Deneysel Özellikler
experimentalToggle.description: Hala geliştirme aşamasında olan deneysel özellikleri etkinleştir.

lazyStreamClose.label: Transkripsiyonlar arasında mikrofonu açık tut
lazyStreamClose.description: Kayıt durdurulduktan sonra mikrofon akışını 30 saniye açık tutar, ardışık transkripsiyonlarda gecikmeyi azaltır. Etkinken Bluetooth ses kalitesini düşürebilir.

transcribe.title: Whisper Hızlandırma
transcribe.description: Whisper modelleri için donanım hızlandırma. Otomatik mod, mevcutsa GPU kullanır (macOS'ta Metal, Windows/Linux'ta Vulkan).

ort.title: ONNX Hızlandırma
ort.description: ONNX modelleri için donanım hızlandırma (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine vb.). Windows'ta DirectML deneyseldir. Modeller transkripsiyon yapamayabilir.

autostart.label: Başlangıçta Çalıştır
autostart.description: Bilgisayara giriş yaptığınızda Escriba otomatik olarak başlatılır.

style.title: Floating indicator
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Konumu
position.description: Kayıt ve transkripsiyon sırasında görsel geri bildirim kaplamasını gösterir. Linux'ta 'Yok' önerilir.

pasteMethod.title: Yapıştırma Yöntemi
pasteMethod.description: Metnin nasıl ekleneceğini seçin. Doğrudan: sistem girişiyle yazmayı simüle eder. Yok: yapıştırmayı atlar, sadece geçmişi/panoyu günceller.

typingTool.title: Yazma Aracı
typingTool.description: Doğrudan yapıştırma yöntemi için hangi Linux yazma aracının kullanılacağını seçin. Auto, sisteminiz için mevcut en iyi aracı otomatik olarak algılar ve kullanır.

clipboardHandling.title: Pano Yönetimi
clipboardHandling.description: Panoyu Değiştirme, transkripsiyon sonrası mevcut pano içeriğini korur. Panoya Kopyala ise yapıştırma işleminden sonra transkripsiyon sonucunu panoda bırakır.

autoSubmit.title: Otomatik Gönder
autoSubmit.description: Metin eklendikten sonra seçilen tuş kombinasyonunu otomatik olarak gönderir. macOS'ta Cmd+Enter, Windows/Linux'ta Super+Enter geçerlidir.

translateToEnglish.label: İngilizceye Çevir
translateToEnglish.description: Transkripsiyon sırasında diğer dillerden İngilizceye otomatik olarak çevirir.

modelUnload.title: Release model from memory
modelUnload.description: Belirtilen süre boyunca kullanılmadığında modelin GPU/CPU belleğini otomatik olarak serbest bırakır.

customWords.title: Özel Kelimeler
customWords.description: Transkripsiyon sırasında sıkça yanlış duyulan veya yanlış yazılan kelimeleri ekleyin. Sistem, benzer sesli kelimeleri listenize göre otomatik olarak düzeltir.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

textReplacements.title: Find & replace
textReplacements.description: Rules applied to the final text after dictation (after AI post-processing). Each rule can be plain text or a regular expression.

hero.title: Advanced
hero.subtitle: Control Escriba’s internal behavior, performance and experimental features.
hero.warning: Only change these options if you know what they do.

advanced.experimentalWarning: Enables tools still in development. They may contain bugs or change between versions.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence bu cihazda kullanılamıyor. macOS Tahoe (26.0) veya üzeri ve Sistem Ayarları'nda Apple Intelligence etkin olan bir Apple Silicon Mac gerektirir.

baseUrl.title: Temel URL
baseUrl.description: Seçili sağlayıcı için API temel URL'si. Yalnızca özel sağlayıcı düzenlenebilir.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Özel uç noktanızın beklediği model tanımlayıcısını girin.
model.descriptionDefault: Seçili sağlayıcının sunduğu bir modeli seçin.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Seçili Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Transkripsiyonları iyileştirmek için bir şablon seçin veya yeni bir tane oluşturun. Yakalanan transkripte referans vermek için prompt metni içinde ${output} kullanın.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Transkripsiyondan sonra çalıştırılacak talimatları yazın. Örnek: Aşağıdaki metnin dilbilgisini ve açıklığını iyileştir: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: İpucu: Transkribe edilen metni promptunuza eklemek için ${output} kullanın.
prompts.selectToEdit: Ayrıntılarını görüntülemek ve düzenlemek için yukarıdan bir prompt seçin.
prompts.createFirst: İlk son işlem prompt'unuzu oluşturmak için yukarıdaki “Yeni Prompt Oluştur” seçeneğine tıklayın.

localLlm.title: Escriba local engine
localLlm.description: Downloads a small AI model (~2.5 GB) that cleans up your dictation on your computer. Free, no API key, your voice never leaves this device.
localLlm.ready: Local engine installed and ready. Dictate with the post-processing shortcut.

targetLanguage.title: Target language
targetLanguage.description: Dictate in any language with the translate shortcut and Escriba pastes the text translated to this language, using the local engine.

postProcessing.heroSubtitle: After you dictate, Escriba can fix, rewrite, summarize or translate your text with AI. You pick the style; the result is ready to paste.

natural.label: Natural dictation
natural.in: hey uh I wanted to let you know that tomorrow I I won't be able to make the meeting
natural.out: I wanted to let you know that tomorrow I won't be able to make the meeting.

email.label: Professional email
email.in: tell the client the report is ready and I'll send it today
email.out:
Dear client,

The report is now ready and I will send it to you today.

Best regards.

notes.label: Quick notes
notes.in: buy batteries call the dentist and finish the proposal before friday
notes.out:
• Buy batteries
• Call the dentist
• Finish the proposal before Friday

translate.label: Translation
translate.in: see you tomorrow at ten at the entrance
translate.out: Nos vemos mañana a las diez en la entrada.

postProcessing.templatesSubtitle: Pick how the AI should transform your dictation. Edit any of them or create your own.

templateDesc.escriba_dictado_natural: Cleans filler words and fixes punctuation while keeping your voice.
templateDesc.escriba_prompt_maestro: Turns loose ideas into a structured prompt for AI.
templateDesc.escriba_whatsapp: A warm message ready to send.
templateDesc.default_improve_transcriptions: Cleans up the transcript in its original language.

appContext.title: Tone by app
appContext.enableDesc: When the active app matches a rule, your dictation is shaped by that template automatically. No shortcuts: dictate the same everywhere.
appContext.empty: No rules yet. Add one so each app gets its own tone.
appContext.hint: Matches by case-insensitive substring. First matching rule wins. Needs the local AI engine.

history.title: Geçmiş
history.empty: Henüz transkripsiyon yok. Geçmişinizi oluşturmak için kayda başlayın!

history.transcriptionFailed: Transkripsiyon başarısız oldu. Yeniden deneme simgesini kullanarak tekrar yazıya dökebilirsiniz.
history.deleteConfirm: This will permanently delete the text and its audio. This can't be undone.

liveLogs.title: Canlı Loglar
liveLogs.description: Sorunları log dosyasını açmadan teşhis etmek için uygulama loglarını gerçek zamanlı olarak akıtın. Yalnızca bu panel açıkken oluşturulan loglar gösterilir; yukarıdaki Log Seviyesi ayarına uyar.

about.closing: Your voice never leaves your computer.

saveAudio.label: Save audio recordings
saveAudio.description: Off by default. Your voice is transcribed and then discarded; only the text is kept in history. Turn this on to keep the .wav files and use the history player.

privacy.remoteProviderNotice: This provider runs in the cloud: the transcribed text is sent to it. Your audio never leaves this computer.

typedText.title: Type your text
typedText.description: Runs the same local AI as dictation, without using your voice: apply your tone or translate. The result appears here so you can copy it.
typedText.placeholder: Write or paste your text here
typedText.disabled: Turn on AI correction first, above.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Taşınabilir kurulumlar otomatik olarak güncellenemez. Güncellemek için: GitHub Releases’ten en son NSIS yükleyicisini indirin, aynı klasöre kurun ve ardından Data/ klasörünüzü (ayarlar, modeller, kayıtlar) eski sürümden yenisine kopyalayın.
footer.updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
footer.updateInstallFailed: The update could not be installed. Please try again later.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Escriba, transkribe edilen metni yazabilmek için erişilebilirlik izinlerine ihtiyaç duyar.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Mikrofon erişimi işletim sistemi tarafından reddedildi. Lütfen sistem ayarlarından mikrofon iznini verin.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Ayarlar → Gizlilik ve güvenlik → Mikrofon (masaüstü uygulama erişimi dahil) bölümünden mikrofon erişimini etkinleştirin.

interpreter.title: Live Interpreter
interpreter.subtitle: You speak, each listener reads and hears the translation in their language on their phone. 100% local, no internet needed beyond a shared WiFi/hotspot.
interpreter.listeningOn: 🎙️ Listening — speak with your dictation shortcut
interpreter.micHint: Hold your dictation shortcut and speak a sentence; it gets translated to every listener's language. (Mic is push-to-talk for now.)
interpreter.scanHint: Scan with your phone camera. Nothing to install.
interpreter.startError: Could not start the room. The port may be busy; try again in a few seconds.
interpreter.networkNote: Heads up: the room travels over your local WiFi unencrypted. On a public network (café, event), use a private hotspot so no one else can read the translations.
interpreter.lanPlaintextWarning: The room travels unencrypted over your local network. Anyone on the same Wi-Fi who inspects traffic could listen in. Avoid it for sensitive meetings.

translator.title: Face-to-face translator
translator.subtitle: Pick two languages. Speak either one with your dictation shortcut; the AI detects it and translates to the other, shown big and read aloud. No phones, no QR — for a one-on-one chat on this screen.
translator.hint: Hold your dictation shortcut and speak in either language.
translator.heroTitle: Talk without speaking the same language.
translator.heroSubtitle: Just talk. Escriba does the rest, translating for both of you in real time.
translator.readAloudHint: Speaks each translation out loud in the other person's language.
translator.previewHint: Start the conversation and your phrases appear here, translated.

retranscribe.title: Re-transcribe this recording with another model

mcp.heroSubtitle: Connect Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client to Escriba's local capabilities: transcribe, translate, summarize and polish. Everything happens on your computer; nothing goes online.
mcp.subtitle: Let AI agents use Escriba's local capabilities as tools. Listens only on 127.0.0.1: nothing leaves your computer.

tool.summarize: Summarize long text down to the essentials.
tool.polish: Fix and polish text: filler words, punctuation, capitals.
tool.list_dictations: Read your recent dictations from history.
tool.usage_stats: Your usage stats: words, streak, minutes saved.

conversation.hintHandsFree: Hands-free is on. Speak normally and each phrase joins the session on its own.
conversation.empty: Nothing yet. Hold your dictation shortcut and say something.
conversation.emptyHandsFree: Nothing yet. Just speak: I'm listening.
conversation.replyFailed: We couldn’t reply. Check the local engine in Post Process.
conversation.docError: We couldn’t create the document. Check the local engine and try again.
conversation.emptyFinish: The session is empty: nothing to convert.
conversation.localNote: Local by default: your voice is always transcribed on your machine. Text only leaves if you turn on a remote provider.
conversation.afterStart: Then every phrase joins the session by holding

privacy.p1: Your voice never leaves your machine.

tts.title: Escriba’s voice
tts.desc: Install the bundled neural voice Escriba replies with. Downloads once and works offline.
tts.error: We couldn’t install the voice. Please try again.

handsFree.label: Hands-free
handsFree.hint: Escriba listens to the room and cuts each intervention on its own. Speak naturally, no shortcut.

systemAudio.label: System audio
systemAudio.hint: Escriba also hears what plays on your computer: the other side of the meeting joins the session as “Others”.
systemAudio.error: Could not start system audio capture.
systemAudio.permissionHint: macOS requires it to capture system audio (the screen itself is not recorded). Grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, then reopen Escriba.
systemAudio.micTip: System audio on. To add your own voice to the session, also enable “Hands-free” (or dictate with your shortcut).
systemAudio.died: System audio capture stopped (permission or audio glitch?). Turn it on again if you're still in the meeting.

systemTranslate.label: Translate
systemTranslate.hint: Translates what plays into your language, and your dictation into the other side's language (John Walter's idea).
systemTranslate.active: Meeting interpreter active (John Walter's idea): what plays arrives in your language, and your dictation is spoken and copied in the other side's language.
systemTranslate.voiceOutHint: Where your translated voice comes out. Pick a virtual microphone (BlackHole) so it is heard inside the video call.
systemTranslate.virtualMicHint: Your translated voice comes out through that device. In your meeting (Meet/Zoom) pick 'BlackHole 2ch' as the microphone: the other person hears only the translation.
systemTranslate.vmInstallHint: Downloads BlackHole 2ch (Existential Audio's open-source virtual microphone) from the official source, SHA256-verified, and installs it. macOS will ask for your password: it is a system audio driver.
systemTranslate.vmReady: Virtual microphone ready: your translated voice now comes out through it. In your meeting, pick 'BlackHole 2ch' as the microphone.
systemTranslate.voiceGenderHint: Gender of the voice that speaks your translation in the meeting.
systemTranslate.neuralHint: Downloads a bundled neural voice (more natural) for this language. Used with female voice; no need for system voices.
systemTranslate.neuralReady: Neural voice ready: your translation will sound more natural.
systemTranslate.replyFailed: Couldn't translate: say it again (nothing went to the meeting).
systemTranslate.notSent: couldn't translate, not sent to the meeting
systemTranslate.vmRestartWarn: Installing the virtual microphone restarts your Mac's audio for a moment and may cut the call. Better to install it before joining. Continue anyway?
systemTranslate.vmUninstallConfirm: Remove BlackHole? The driver is uninstalled and your Mac's audio restarts.
systemTranslate.vmInstallFailed: The installation didn't finish. Try again.
systemTranslate.vmShaFailed: The download failed the integrity check. Discarded.

engine.requiredTitle: This feature needs the local AI engine
engine.requiredBody: Translations, replies and documents are generated on your computer, no cloud. Download the engine once (~2.5 GB) from Post Process. Ollama works too.

a11y.previewSound: Preview sound theme (plays start then stop)

obsidian.sent: Note saved to your Obsidian vault
obsidian.firstTimeHint: First, choose your Obsidian vault folder. Only this once.
obsidian.vaultMissingHint: Your vault folder is no longer there. Choose it again.
obsidian.vaultDescription: Folder where 'Send to Obsidian' writes its notes, from Sessions and Studio. It must be inside your home folder.
obsidian.previewTitle: Review before saving to your vault
obsidian.previewDescription: Nothing reaches your vault until you confirm. Edit whatever you want first.
obsidian.noteTitleHint: Becomes the file name inside your vault.
obsidian.folderHint: Notes go into “{{folder}}”. It gets created on first use.
obsidian.folderHintRoot: Empty: notes land loose in your vault root.
obsidian.linkedHint: {{count}} mention(s) linked to existing notes. Edit freely: nothing is written until you save.

linkMentions.label: Link mentions to existing notes
linkMentions.description: When exporting, names that match notes in your vault become [[links]]. You always review them in the preview before saving. Only note names are read, never their contents.

indexNote.label: Keep an index note
indexNote.description: Escriba maintains Escriba.md with links to every exported note. It only rewrites its own block: anything you write outside it survives.

dailyInbox.label: Daily inbox
dailyInbox.description: Adds a "Send to inbox" action to history entries: the dictation lands in a daily Inbox note with its time, no dialog. The reviewed path is still the normal export.

obsidian.inboxSaved: Sent to today's inbox in your vault.
obsidian.inboxNoVault: Choose your Obsidian vault first (Settings, Obsidian section).
obsidian.inboxFailed: Could not write to the inbox note.

welcome.title: I'm Plumín, and I'll walk you through this
welcome.narration: In a few minutes you'll be dictating. I'll show you what matters; everything else you can change later.

local.title: I listen right here
local.body: Speech recognition runs on your computer. Your voice never leaves it.

noCloud.title: No cloud involved
noCloud.body: Works without internet. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

noAccount.title: No account, no subscription
noAccount.body: Nothing to sign up for. Free, with no usage limit.

model.title: Choose how I'll hear you
model.narration: This is the model that turns your voice into text. It starts downloading as soon as you pick one, and keeps going while we finish the rest.

engine.title: And this one is for thinking, not just writing
engine.narration: An AI engine that runs on your machine. It's optional: skip it and dictation still works.

unlocks.polish: Polishing what you dictate: fillers out, punctuation in, and a tone per app
unlocks.translate: Translating as you dictate, and the meeting Interpreter
unlocks.sessions: Minutes and notes when a session ends

engine.sizeNote: About 2.5 GB. You can install it later from Settings → Post Processing.

shortcut.title: Your shortcut to talk to me
shortcut.narration: Hold it down, say what you want, let go. The text appears wherever your cursor is, in any app.
shortcut.note: Works in any app: the text lands wherever your cursor is, no copy-paste. And if you dictate in your editor or your mail client, Escriba can match the tone of each one.

obsidian.title: Do you keep notes in Obsidian?
obsidian.narration: I can leave your transcriptions and session minutes there as real notes. Without going through the internet.

test.title: Now tell me something
test.narration: Press the microphone and speak. I want you to see your words before we go on.
test.titleDone: You wrote that with your voice
test.narrationDone: And I can do more with it. Try me: translate it.
test.translationNote: Translated on your machine, nothing sent.
test.shortcutHint: Outside of here, your shortcut is
test.translateFailed: Couldn't translate. Check the local engine in Settings.
test.needsEngine: Translating needs the local engine, the one I offered two steps back. You can install it later from Settings → Post Processing.
